moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def by 2 stat ranks. If the remaining MP for the user’s Super Effective ↑ is one or more when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by one and grants all of the following effects: Applies the Supereffective ↑ Next effect to all allied sync pairs. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 2 ranks.

passives.name: Galar Rush
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] the first time it enters a battle each battle. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] the first time your team enters a battle each battle instead. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] you have on your team, the greater the reduction is. (Each additional sync pair increases the reduction by one, and the maximum reduction is three.) The effects do not stack if you have more than one sync pair on your team with passive skills of the same name.

passives.name: Hometown Cheers
passives.description: Raises the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="1" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="2" S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time it turns the field of play’s zone into an [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] each battle. Raises the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="4" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="5" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="5" S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time it turns the field of play’s zone into an [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="3" ] each battle.

passives.name: Returning Cheers with a Smile
passives.description: Grants all of the following effects after the user uses its max move: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ]. Restores [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] MP of the user’s [Name:MoveId Idx="19160" ].
